brief: Prioritise Rushmere Junction for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with high loading history have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under multi-day heat events (MG-023). Because this event involves consecutive warm nights, run forced cooling continuously through the overnight period rather than allowing the thermostat to drop the stages out (MG-025). If this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023).
